    "None felt like something I would choose now: metal-cutting wheels, hose clamps, and wiring grommets serve tasks I have not been shopping for.",
    "The locking nuts look related to my fastener purchases, but they do not work with the wood screws and framing nails I have been buying.",
    "Glue and tape do not meet the same need as my specific wood fasteners, and twelve tubes of glue or eighteen rolls of tape give me no reason to buy without a current use.",
    "The caliper and infrared thermometer would require measurement tasks that my recent purchases do not suggest."

  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying construction fasteners seems to have been taken as interest in almost any workshop or repair supply.",
    "Items that attach or secure things seem to have been treated as interchangeable, although screws, nuts, adhesives, and tape solve different problems."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated nail and screw purchases point toward specific fastening needs, where dimensions, material, and tool compatibility matter.",
    "My medicine cups and vacuum bags reflect separate practical needs; they do not make unrelated repair supplies useful to me.",
    "I need a clear current purpose before choosing an item. Buying large packs of fasteners does not mean I need bulk quantities of other supplies."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations picked up a broad repair-supply interest but missed the specific tasks and compatibility that make an item useful to me now."
